# logging

OpenShift Logging operator and forwarders to syslog, Splunk or HTTP receivers. The loki element adds log storage, its own forwarder and the console UI.

Guide: https://policystk.io/elements/logging/

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  logging:
    enabled: true
```

## Optional pieces

Shipped with `enabled: false`. Turn one on in a values layer.

| Entry | Description | Turn on with |
|---|---|---|
| Policy [`forwarders`](#policy-forwarders) | Forward logs to syslog, Splunk or HTTP receivers | `policies.forwarders.enabled: true` |

## Settings

Read only by the forwarders policy, which ships enabled: false.

Under `stack.logging.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `forwarders` | ClusterLogForwarder name in openshift-logging: {type, url, logTypes, rfc, index, secret, enabled}. type is syslog, splunk or http. url is tls://, tcp:// or udp:// for syslog, https:// or http:// otherwise. logTypes lists application, infrastructure and/or audit. rfc is RFC5424 (default) or RFC3164, syslog only. index is the Splunk index, Splunk only. secret is {name, ca, certificate, key, token, username, password}: name is a Secret in the hub's policy namespace, each other key names the Secret key that feeds one field. enabled: false deletes the forwarder; deleting the entry leaves it unmanaged. The name is 3-54 characters, ends with a letter or digit and is not logging. The layer that turns forwarders on fills it | `{}` |

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-cluster-logging` | `cluster-logging` | `stable-6.5` | `redhat-operators` | `openshift-logging` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `forwarders`

`forwarders-logging-<cluster>`: Forward logs to syslog, Splunk or HTTP receivers. Depends on `install-logging-<cluster>`. Off by default; turn on with `policies.forwarders.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `forwarders-clusterlogforwarders` | enforce | medium | `install-cluster-logging-status`<br>`forwarders-collectors`<br>compliant while pending | [clusterlogforwarders](converters/forwarders/clusterlogforwarders.yaml) (mustonlyhave) | ClusterLogForwarder per forwarder |
| `forwarders-collectors` | enforce | medium |  | [collectors](converters/forwarders/collectors.yaml) | Collector ServiceAccount and log type ClusterRoleBindings per forwarder |
| `forwarders-outputs` | enforce | medium |  | [outputs](converters/forwarders/outputs.yaml) | Output Secret per forwarder, copied from the hub |
| `forwarders-ready` | inform (always) | medium |  | [ready](converters/forwarders/ready.yaml) | Reports NonCompliant until each forwarder is Ready and every collector pod is ready |
| `forwarders-removed` | enforce | medium | `install-cluster-logging-status`<br>`forwarders-clusterlogforwarders`<br>compliant while pending | [removed](converters/forwarders/removed.yaml) | Deletes disabled forwarders, unused log type bindings and unused output Secrets |

### Policy `install`

`install-logging-<cluster>`: Policy for any operator installation.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-cluster-logging` | enforce | high | [operator](#operators) `cluster-logging` | Installs the OpenShift logging operator |
